description: Parameters needed to the corresponding task specification in eTaSL

from-core_task_lib-version-1.0.1.description:
Library core_task_lib version 1.0.1.
 Set to true to indicate that task specification comes from the library above. 
 Library description: Library with basic task specifications that may be needed in most applications
Authors: Santiago Iregui (KU Leuven), Erwin Aertbeliën (KU Leuven), Federico Ulloa (KU Leuven)

file_path.description: File path of the corresponding task specification

parameters.description: List of parameters needed to define an instance of the task specification

target_joints.description: Target values of the joints listed in robot_joints, in the same order (same length as robot_joints). Expressed in radians or degrees according to the units parameter (prismatic joints in meters; with units=degrees every value is multiplied by pi/180, so use radians when prismatic joints are included)

robot_joints.description: Names of the robot joints (as defined in the robot model) to be moved with the trapezoidal velocity profile. Must have the same length as target_joints and fewer elements than the total number of robot joints

time_margin.description: Extra time [s] that the task keeps running (holding the target) after the planned duration of the trapezoidal profile has elapsed, before the exit monitor finishes the task. Gives the joints time to settle at the target

maxacc.description: Maximum joint acceleration [rad/s^2] (or [m/s^2] for prismatic joints) of the trapezoidal profile, applied to every moved joint. Always given in SI units, independently of the units parameter

K_joint.description: Feedback gain [1/s] of the joint trajectory tracking constraints (same for all moved joints). Larger values reduce the tracking error w.r.t. the trapezoidal profile faster; too large values can cause oscillations or saturate the joint velocities

units.description: Units of the angles given in target_joints: radians or degrees (degrees are converted to radians). It does not affect maxvel/maxacc

maxvel.description: Maximum joint velocity [rad/s] (or [m/s] for prismatic joints) of the trapezoidal profile, applied to every moved joint. The profiles of all joints are synchronized, so only the joint with the longest motion reaches this limit. Always given in SI units, independently of the units parameter

is-move_jointspace_trap_subset.description:
Task Specification: move_jointspace_trap_subset.etasl.lua
Set to true to indicate that the task uses the task specification mentioned above. 
 Task description: Moves a subset of the robot joints (the joint names given in robot_joints) from their current values to the target joint values (target_joints); the other joints are not commanded by this task (they remain still unless other constraints move them).
Each selected joint follows a trapezoidal velocity profile from its initial to its target value, limited by maxvel/maxacc; the profiles are synchronized so that all selected joints start and finish at the same time. The joints track these profiles with feedback constraints.
No input channels are used. The task exits time_margin seconds (default 2 s) after the planned duration of the motion. Outputs: time, the positions of all robot joints (jpos1, jpos2, ...) and the tracking errors of the moved joints (tracking_error_<joint name>).
